selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method MSDDN --arm original --train-set gf2 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MSDDN/original/gf2_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method MSDDN --arm original --train-set gf2 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/MSDDN/original/gf2_full
runtime_note: RR table values were computed in float32 on CPU. On GPU this network's output differs from the CPU result by 0.9-10 dB PSNR even with TF32 disabled (FFT branch; checked 2026-11-23), so evaluate it on CPU (about 15-30 s per test set).
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
